uslaw-usc-t2-s142l:
Section 142l of Title 2 of the United States Code covers the Disbursing Officer of the Library of Congress. It sits in Chapter 5 of that title, on the Library of Congress. The section deals with payments for the Office of Congressional Workplace Rights, named in the text by its former name, the Office of Compliance. From 1 October 1996, that officer is cleared to pay out funds.

The funds are those appropriated for that office. The Library of Congress is also to give that office support in the management of its funds. Such support is given as the two sides may need and agree on, with the Librarian named in the text. The heading also covers voucher sign-off and relief by the Comptroller General. The text is current through Public Law 119-134.
